articles.summary: We benchmarked our places agent against GPT-5.5, o3-deep-research, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Claude Opus 4.8 on real-world human-verified places in Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia. The general agents do well on the easy web, but Reprompt outperforms on difficult geographies and tasks requiring deeper research.
articles.title: Reprompt outperforms OpenAI, Claude, Gemini on hard places research tasks
